concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑003 (stability of anomaly detection across σ thresholds) is not explicitly addressed in the plan. The plan mentions a sensitivity sweep over {0.5σ, 1.0σ, 1.5σ} (FR‑007) but does not state that the variation in significance rates or inconsistency rates will be measured and reported as required by SC‑003.

The Data Acquisition table includes a “Pressure Test Subset (fallback)” entry with no verified source and notes it is “not used in the primary pipeline”. This artifact is not required by any FR or SC and adds unnecessary scope; it should be removed or clearly marked as out‑of‑scope to avoid over‑reach.
